title: UART link with baud check

implements.text: Byte time from the baud rate and frame format 8N1, 8E1 or 8N2
A device whose baud differs by more than 3 percent receives garbled bytes and an event

unsupported.text: Start and stop bit edges, framing errors and parity errors

knownFailureCases: No test in the repository exercises the link yet
